category_note: Hand-built product UI animation (no capture, no search). Closest catalog category is webpage (UI animation); content is product-supplied from the repo source.
style: data-peek motion kit: dark canvas #101216, one raised window panel (3px hairline border, 22px radius) filling the frame with an 80px safe margin, soft static radial accent-deep glow. Geist Mono carries SQL and data. Quiet confidence: expo.out / power3.out for UI, power2.in for the one exit, sine for the ambient ping. No bounce, no elastic.
font: Geist Variable (UI labels) + Geist Mono Variable (SQL, grid, chips), local woff2
loop: seamless; frame 0 and t=5.967 show the same seven rows, no diff highlights, pill 'Watching · 1s', ping ring invisible

queries: data table new row insert slide down
catalog_search.decision: Hand-author. No registry item animates a data-grid cell diff, a keyed row insert or a status ping. The hits are text highlights, camera flashes and broadcast tickers. Technique borrowed from code-highlight: a band that snaps on and then decays, applied per cell.

window.sql: SELECT id, host, status, in_flight, lag_ms FROM workers ORDER BY id DESC;

content.countdown: pill reads ceil(ms to next tick): 1s on [0,0.5), 2s on [0.5,1.5), 1s on [1.5,2.5), … 1s on [5.5,6)

shots.what: Watched grid at rest; the ping breathes on the tab dot and the pill.
Tick 1: four cells flash amber (fill + left stripe) at once, the new values settle in, and the flashes fade.
PATTERN INTERRUPT, tick 2: rows slide down one slot (expo.out 0.5s), and ingest-08 fades in at the top with a full-width green band that then decays. Footer reads 8 rows.
Tick 3: ingest-08 fades out (power2.in), rows slide back up, and worker 6 and worker 2 flash amber as their values return.

brief: One watched query, three re-runs, no narration. The data-peek grid sits under a tab whose amber dot quietly breathes. Every two seconds the query runs again. Cells that changed light up amber and fade, and once a brand-new row pushes in at the top on a green band. By the last frame, everything has settled back to where it started, so the loop never shows a seam. Dominant motif: the amber cell flash. Pattern interrupt: the green-band row entrance at 2.5 s.
